cards.front: Me habría gustado haber estado allí.
cards.back: I would have liked to have been there.

cards.front: Me habría gustado haberlo sabido.
cards.back: I would have liked to have known.

cards.front: Me habría gustado haber sido informado.
cards.back: I would have liked to have been told.

cards.front: Me habría gustado haber participado.
cards.back: I would have liked to have taken part.

cards.front: Me habría gustado haberlo visto con mis propios ojos.
cards.back: I would have liked to have seen it with my own eyes.

cards.front: Me habría gustado haberle dicho a ella lo que pensaba.
cards.back: I would have liked to have told her what I thought.

cards.front: No me habría gustado haber estado en su pellejo (de ella).
cards.back: I wouldn't have liked to have been in her shoes.

cards.front: No me habría gustado haber estado en su pellejo (de ellos).
cards.back: I wouldn't have liked to have been in their shoes.

cards.front: No me habría gustado haber estado en tu pellejo.
cards.back: I wouldn't have liked to have been in your shoes.

cards.front: Me habría encantado haber visto su cara (de ella).
cards.back: I'd have loved to have seen the look on her face.

cards.front: Me habría encantado haberte visto la cara.
cards.back: I'd have loved to have seen the look on your face.

cards.front: A mí me habría encantado haber hecho algo así de joven.
cards.back: I'd have loved to have done something like that when I was young.

cards.front: Habría dado mi brazo derecho por haberle visto la cara a él.
cards.back: I would have given my right arm to have seen the look on his face.

cards.front: Habría dado mi brazo derecho por haber estado en su pellejo (de él).
cards.back: I would have given my right arm to have been in his shoes.

cards.front: Habría dado mi brazo derecho por haber tenido esa información hace dos semanas.
cards.back: I would have given my right arm to have had that information two weeks ago.

cards.front: Preferiría tomar café antes que un postre.
cards.back: I'd rather have a coffee than a dessert.

cards.front: Preferiría ir al cine antes que ir al teatro.
cards.back: I'd rather go to the cinema than go to the theatre.

cards.front: Preferiría cortarme un brazo a escuchar un minuto más de su discurso.
cards.back: I'd rather cut my own arm off than listen to another minute of his speech.

cards.front: Yo habría preferido haber hecho el curso avanzado en vez del intermedio.
cards.back: I'd rather have done the advanced course than the intermediate one.

cards.front: Habrían preferido haber ido a ver el musical en vez de a la ópera.
cards.back: They'd rather have gone to see a musical than gone to the opera.

cards.front: Habríamos preferido habernos casado en Las Vegas en vez de en Salt Lake City.
cards.back: We'd rather have gotten married in Las Vegas than in Salt Lake City.

cards.front: Preferiría no pasar las vacaciones buscando antigüedades.
cards.back: I'd rather not spend my vacations looking for antiques.

cards.front: Ella preferiría no tener que gritar cada vez que quiere decir algo.
cards.back: She'd rather not have to shout every time she wants to say something.

cards.front: Él preferiría no ir de pesca este fin de semana.
cards.back: He'd rather not go fishing this weekend.

cards.front: Habría preferido no haber tenido que decir la verdad a todos sobre lo que pasó.
cards.back: I'd rather not have had to tell everyone the truth about what happened.

cards.front: Habríamos preferido no haberlo descubierto por casualidad.
cards.back: We'd rather not have found out by accident.

cards.front: Habrían preferido no haber visitado el museo.
cards.back: They'd rather not have visited the museum.

cards.front: Preferiría que tú fueras a la reunión en vez de mí.
cards.back: I'd rather you went to the meeting instead of me.

cards.front: Preferiría que ella escribiera el artículo en vez de él.
cards.back: I'd rather she wrote the article instead of him.

cards.front: Preferiría que terminaras tus deberes antes de irte a la fiesta.
cards.back: I'd rather you finished your homework before going to the party.

cards.front: ¿Quieres un polo o prefieres un helado?
cards.back: Do you want an ice lolly or would you rather have an ice cream?

cards.front: ¿Quieres jugar al fútbol o prefieres jugar al baloncesto?
cards.back: Do you want to play football or would you rather play basketball?

cards.front: ¿Quieres un filete para la cena o prefieres pescado?
cards.back: Do you want steak for dinner or would you rather have fish?

cards.front: ¿Quisiste ir a Francia o habrías preferido haber ido a Italia?
cards.back: Did you want to go to France or would you rather have gone to Italy?

cards.front: ¿Quisiste estudiar geografía o habrías preferido haber estudiado geología?
cards.back: Did you want to study geography or would you rather have studied geology?

cards.front: ¿Quisiste visitar el Louvre o habrías preferido haber visitado la Torre Eiffel?
cards.back: Did you want to visit the Louvre or would you rather have visited the Eiffel Tower?

cards.front: ¿Prefieres no arriesgarlo?
cards.back: Would you rather not risk it?

cards.front: ¿Prefieres no hacer el examen todavía?
cards.back: Would you rather not take the exam yet?

cards.front: ¿Prefieres no decírselo a nadie?
cards.back: Would you rather not tell anyone about it?

cards.front: ¿Habrías preferido no haberle hablado?
cards.back: Would you rather not have spoken to him?

cards.front: ¿Habrías preferido no haber ido a la reunión?
cards.back: Would you rather not have gone to the meeting?

cards.front: ¿Habrías preferido no haber tenido que perder el tiempo buscando una plaza de aparcamiento?
cards.back: Would you rather not have had to waste time looking for a parking space?

cards.front: ¿Quieres hacerlo tú o prefieres que él lo haga por ti?
cards.back: Do you want to do it or would you rather he did it for you?

cards.front: ¿Quieres comprar una copia o prefieres que yo me adelante y te compre una?
cards.back: Do you want to buy a copy or would you rather I went ahead and bought you one?

cards.front: ¿Te importa llevarles o prefieres que ellos lleven su propio coche?
cards.back: Do you mind giving them a lift or would you rather they took their own car?

cards.front: Probablemente lloverá, sobre todo si no traemos paraguas.
cards.back: It's likely to rain, especially if we don't bring umbrellas.

cards.front: Tienes más probabilidad de morir por el golpe de un coco que cae de un árbol que por el ataque de un tiburón.
cards.back: You're more likely to be killed by a falling coconut than by a shark attack.

cards.front: Por lo visto, él ha caído enfermo por una intoxicación. ¡Todo un clásico!
cards.back: Apparently, he's come down with food poisoning. A likely story!

cards.front: Es más que probable que ella esté de vacaciones en un centro turístico de lujo en algún lugar paradisíaco.
cards.back: She's more than likely to be on vacation in a luxury resort somewhere heavenly.

cards.front: Es más que probable que sea un desastre si involucramos a todo el mundo.
cards.back: It's more than likely to be a disaster if we get everybody involved.

cards.front: Es más que probable que anuncien la noticia el viernes por la tarde.
cards.back: They'll more than likely announce the news on Friday afternoon.

cards.front: Es improbable que ganemos, teniendo en cuenta nuestro lamentable estado de forma actual.
cards.back: We're unlikely to win given our pitiful form at the moment.

cards.front: En el caso improbable de tener que aterrizar en el agua, los chalecos salvavidas están debajo de sus asientos.
cards.back: In the unlikely event of having to land on water, lifejackets are stowed under your seats.

cards.front: Puede que nieve mañana, pero es improbable que cuaje.
cards.back: It might snow tomorrow, but it's unlikely to settle.

cards.front: Es muy poco probable que el volcán entre en erupción mientras estamos allí; la última erupción fue hace más de 300 años.
cards.back: It's highly unlikely that the volcano will erupt while we're there; the last eruption was over 300 years ago.

cards.front: Como es muy poco probable que alguna vez ganes la lotería, más vale que empieces a pensar en otras formas de ahorrar.
cards.back: As it's highly unlikely that you'll ever win the lottery, you'd better start to think of ways to economize.

cards.front: Supongo que él habría podido hacerlo todo solo, pero suena muy poco probable.
cards.back: I suppose that he could have done it all by himself, but it sounds highly unlikely.

cards.front: ¿Es probable que el precio baje en un futuro próximo?
cards.back: Is the price likely to go down in the near future?

cards.front: ¿Es probable que estén por aquí este fin de semana?
cards.back: Are they likely to be around this weekend?

cards.front: ¿Es probable que baje de cero esta noche?
cards.back: Is it likely to go below freezing tonight?

cards.front: ¿Qué posibilidades hay de que se tome una decisión rápida?
cards.back: What's the likelihood of a quick decision?

cards.front: ¿Qué posibilidades hay de encontrar trabajo antes de Navidad?
cards.back: What's the likelihood of finding a job before Christmas?

cards.front: ¿Qué posibilidades hay de que encontremos trabajo antes de Navidad?
cards.back: What's the likelihood of us finding a job before Christmas?

cards.front: La probabilidad de que eso suceda es cero.
cards.back: The likelihood of that happening is zero.

cards.front: La probabilidad de que él tenga éxito es mayor si empieza a preparar la campaña ahora.
cards.back: The likelihood of him being successful is greater if he starts preparing the campaign now.

cards.front: Si sigue bebiendo y fumando así, aumentará las probabilidades de que se ponga enfermo.
cards.back: If he keeps drinking and smoking like that, it will increase the likelihood of him getting ill.

cards.front: Es muy poco probable que suceda eso.
cards.back: There isn't much likelihood of that happening.

cards.front: No hay mucha probabilidad de que él cambie de opinión.
cards.back: There isn't much likelihood of him changing his mind.

cards.front: Es muy poco probable que vengan a la rueda de prensa.
cards.back: There isn't much likelihood of them coming to the press conference.

cards.front: Lo más probable es que la fiesta se acabe antes de medianoche.
cards.back: In all likelihood the party will be finished by midnight.

cards.front: Lo más probable es que no lleguemos antes de la hora de comer.
cards.back: In all likelihood we won't get there before lunchtime.

cards.front: Lo más probable es que ya se hayan marchado.
cards.back: In all likelihood they've already left.

cards.front: ¡No van a ganar ni en sus sueños!
cards.back: Fat chance they've got of winning!

cards.front: ¡Ni en sueños nos va a dar el jefe un aumento de sueldo!
cards.back: There's fat chance of the boss giving us a raise!

cards.front: Las probabilidades de que él pierda peso con este régimen son cero.
cards.back: There's fat chance of him losing weight on this new diet!

cards.front: Les gustó mucho tu idea.
cards.back: They were very keen on your idea.

cards.front: No le apetecía mucho ir a él.
cards.back: He wasn't keen on going.

cards.front: No me gusta mucho su nueva novia.
cards.back: I'm not too keen on his new girlfriend.

cards.front: Me está gustando mucho cocinar últimamente.
cards.back: I've been really into cooking lately.

cards.front: ¿No vas a pedirle a ella que salga contigo? Pensaba que te gustaba mucho.
cards.back: Aren't you going to ask her to go out with you? I thought you were really into her.

cards.front: No creo que vaya con vosotros a ver esa peli; no me gustan mucho las películas de ciencia ficción.
cards.back: I don't think I'll go and see that film with you; I'm not into science fiction films.

cards.front: Sabes que tengo cierta debilidad por un buen desayuno inglés.
cards.back: You know I'm very partial to a good English breakfast.

cards.front: No le ofrezcas vino a ella; no le gusta mucho el alcohol.
cards.back: Don't offer her any wine; she's not partial to alcohol.

cards.front: Toda la comida aquí es genial, pero siento especial debilidad por las ostras.
cards.back: All the food is great here, but I'm particularly partial to the oysters.

cards.front: Sabes que siempre he tenido un cariño especial por ti.
cards.back: You know I've always had a soft spot for you.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no se lo pides tú? Ella tiene debilidad por ti.
cards.back: Why don't you ask her? She's got a soft spot for you.

cards.front: Creo que definitivamente ella tiene debilidad por los hombres con uniforme.
cards.back: I think she has a definite soft spot for men in uniform!

cards.front: A mí no me gusta mucho la ópera, la verdad.
cards.back: Opera isn't really my cup of tea.

cards.front: ¡El fútbol no es del gusto de todos!, ¿sabes?
cards.back: Football isn't everybody's cup of tea, you know!

cards.front: Bueno, quizá te sorprenda saber que la física cuántica no me va mucho.
cards.back: Well, you might be surprised to hear that quantum physics isn't my cup of tea.
